stem: Which of the following is a possible benefit of increased population?

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: The Ohlin model assumes which of the following as identical among all the trading countries?

stem: The problems of ‘double taxation’ in international trade can be overcome by

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: When did the World Trade Organization come into effect?

stem: Which of the following is a reason for India to be a developing country?

stem: Green Revolution means

stem: The first ever Industrial Policy Resolution of India was announced in the year

stem: The sectors are classified into public and private sectors on the basis of

stem: What is the effective measure of poverty alleviation?

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Who among the following suggested poverty line of R75 per capita per year?

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which measures of dispersion are used to compare the distribution of two or more data sets?

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: The slope of the regression line of Y on X is also referred to as the

options.A: regression coefficient of X on Y
options.B: regression coefficient of Y on X

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: What will be the value of X for which the value of cos X is minimum?

stem: Which of the following are the central problems of the economy?

stem: Which of the following cost curves is/are rectangular hyperbola in shape?

stem: Which of the following is/are leakage/s from the circular flow of income?

stem: Which of the following is/are assumption/s of classical theory of employment?

options.B: There is always full employment in the economy
options.D: More than one of the above

note: Say's law (supply creates demand/'demand creates own supply') + always full employment are classical assumptions; wages/prices are flexible not rigid. A&B -> D.

stem: Which of the following agency/agencies deal with Foreign Exchange rate system in the World?

options.D: More than one of the above

note: IMF administers the international exchange-rate system.

stem: Monotonicity of preference implies:

options.B: Budget line is tangent to Indifference curve
options.C: Indifference curve is concave to origin
options.D: More than one of the above

note: Monotonicity (more is better) implies indifference curve is downward sloping.

stem: Production Possibility Frontier curve shows a combination of goods that :

options.D: More than one of the above

note: PPF shows combinations of goods an economy can produce with given resources.

stem: "If too much money is chasing too few goods", the resulting inflation can be called:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Too much money chasing too few goods = demand-pull inflation.

stem: The primary purpose of Monetary Policy is to maintain:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Primary purpose of monetary policy is price stability.

stem: The characteristic/s of public goods is/are:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Public goods are non-rival and non-excludable; 'rivalrous' and 'no free riders' are wrong. Only B correct.

stem: Data on employment can be obtained from:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Employment data sources: Census, NSSO, and DGE&T — all three. More than one -> D.

stem: Adam Smith advocated:

stem: Which of the following is/are NOT indicator/s of an economically developed nation?

options.C: A high proportion of labour in the primary sector

note: High share of labour in primary sector is NOT an indicator of development (literacy & per-capita income are).

stem: Which of the following is/are component/s of capital account?

options.D: More than one of the above

note: FDI is a capital-account component; export of goods and trade in services are current account. Only A.

stem: Cardinal utility analysis assumes that:

options.A: Level of utility can be expressed in numbers
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Under Marginal Productivity theory, reward for labour is determined by:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Reward for labour = its marginal product.

stem: Which of the following is/are Normative statement/s?

options.A: Poverty is a state of condition where people are not able to meet their needs

options.C: Government should take measures to control unemployment and poverty
options.D: More than one of the above

note: 'Government should take measures...' is normative (ought); others are positive statements.

stem: Example/s of Cobb Douglas production function is/are:

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which of the following statement/s is/are correct about elasticity of demand

options.A: It is percentage change in demand for the good divided by percentage change in its price
options.B: Elasticity of demand is same at different points on a linear demand curve
options.C: Elasticity of demand of necessity goods is highly elastic
options.D: More than one of the above

note: A = definition of price elasticity. Elasticity varies along linear demand curve (B false); necessities are inelastic (C false).

stem: Suppose a firm increases it's input by 30% and the output increases by 20%. The firm's production function exhibits:

options.C: Diminishing marginal rate of technical substitution
options.D: More than one of the above

note: All inputs +30%, output +20% (less than proportionate) = decreasing/diminishing returns to scale.

stem: Percentiles divide a series into:

stem: The algebraic sum of deviation of a set of n values from arithmetic mean is:

stem: The foreign exchange transactions that are dependent on other transactions are:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Accommodating transactions are BoP transactions undertaken to cover a deficit/surplus (dependent on other/autonomous transactions); autonomous ones are independent.

stem: Which of the following is/are NOT a property/ properties of an isoquant curve?

options.B: Higher isoquant means higher level of production
options.D: More than one of the above

note: An isoquant is CONVEX to the origin, not concave, so C is NOT a property. A and B are genuine properties.

stem: Marginal revenue refers to:

stem: According to keynes, speculative demand for money depends upon:

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Keynesian speculative demand for money is a function of the rate of interest (inverse).

stem: Which of the following is/are NOT a function/s of money?

options.B: Making demand and supply of goods equal
options.D: More than one of the above

note: Functions of money = medium of exchange, store of value, unit of account, standard of deferred payment. 'Making demand and supply of goods equal' is NOT a function.

stem: Gross Fiscal Deficit reflects :

options.D: More than one of the above

note: GFD (financing side) = net borrowing at home + borrowing from RBI + borrowing from abroad. All three A,B,C are components -> More than one.

stem: According to Wagner's Law:

options.A: Activities of government have a tendency to increase over time
options.B: The private sector rises faster than government sector
options.C: Proportion of public sector in the economy falls
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which of the following is/are NOT canon/s of taxation?

options.D: More than one of the above

note: Equity, efficiency and revenue adequacy (fiscal adequacy/productivity) are all recognised principles/canons of a good tax system -> none is NOT a canon. Ambiguous: some keys mark 'Efficiency' (C); flagged low.

stem: AASTHI project for GIS based property tax system is an initiative of which of the following state/s?

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: The distribution of the burden of paying a tax is called:

stem: The industrial license was abolished for most industries except______ during 1991 reforms.

options.D: More than one of the above

options.A: The speculative money demand is infinitely elastic
options.B: The rate of interest is very high
options.C: Everyone expects rate of interest to fall further
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: 15th Finance Commission report recommended :

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which of the following is/are correct about money multiplier?

options.C: It depends upon demand deposits with banks
options.D: More than one of the above

options.D: More than one of the above

options.A: Quasi rent does not exist in long run
options.B: It is fixed in short run
options.C: It is applicable on man made goods
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which of the following items is/are excluded from National Income measurement?

options.A: Proceeds from sale of second hand goods
options.B: Proceeds from brokerage by selling second hand goods
options.C: Value of goods for self consumption
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Examples of Positive Externalities are:

options.B: Effect of coal factory on neighbourhood
options.C: Effect of throwing garbage on the road
options.D: More than one of the above

stem: In the simple keynesian model, consumption is a function of:

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Human Resource Development was focus on:

options.D: More than one of the above

stem: Which of the following is NOT correct about sustainable goals?
